description: Terminal layout shared by all three agents (README.md, 'Terminal output').
width: the column at which output wraps (the terminal's width is used if narrower).
show_time: print how long each response took.
show_tokens: print the tokens each response used (in: sent to the model, out: generated)
and how many model calls it took.
links: show Markdown links and web addresses as clickable terminal links
Everything except the model's answer prints in dark gray (ANSI 90).
